units.source_text: “是呵……”老头像刚刚唠完家常似的从椅子上站起来，用若无其事的调子说，

en.t: "Is that so..." The old man stood up from his chair as though he had just finished chatting about ordinary things, and said in an offhand tone,

units.source_text: “那么，就请多多包涵了……我们尽可能照顾你啦……”

en.t: "Well then, please bear with us... We will take care of you as best we can..."
